metadata.description: Normalized DoD legislative tracker records. Run npm run sync:congress after adding Congress.gov identifiers and CONGRESS_GOV_API_KEY.

records.title: National Defense Authorization Act oversight track

sponsors.fullName: House and Senate Armed Services leadership

records.plainSummary: Annual defense policy package that can authorize programs, procurement authorities, reporting requirements, and implementation rules affecting the Department of Defense and its contractors.
records.fundingContractSignal: Watch for acquisition reform language, production scaling authorities, contractor reporting requirements, and incentive structures for delivery speed or cost control.
records.regulationBonusWatch: Track amendments that condition awards, milestone payments, award fees, or executive bonuses on performance, cybersecurity, or domestic sourcing.
records.nextAction: Monitor subcommittee markups, amendment text, manager packages, and committee reports for contractor-facing provisions.

records.title: Department of Defense appropriations and spending directives

house.label: Official House committee and floor votes pending

senate.label: Official Senate committee and floor votes pending

records.plainSummary: Tracks actual spending levels, earmarks, program increases or cuts, and explanatory report language that directs how DoD funds flow to programs and vendors.
records.fundingContractSignal: Flag plus-ups, rescissions, reprogramming limits, and report directives that affect prime contractors, subcontractors, and grant recipients.
records.regulationBonusWatch: Watch for restrictions on using funds for certain vendors, foreign sourcing, consulting contracts, or incentive compensation.
records.nextAction: Compare bill tables and explanatory statements against DoD budget justification books to identify winners, losers, and constraints.

records.title: Defense contractor cybersecurity and CMMC implementation

sponsors.fullName: Armed Services and Homeland Security oversight members

committeeReferral: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
records.plainSummary: Focuses on cyber requirements for companies that receive DoD contracts, including certification timing, incident reporting, audit burden, and small-business compliance costs.
records.fundingContractSignal: Track whether compliance costs are reimbursable, whether certification becomes a condition of award, and how primes must police subcontractors.
records.regulationBonusWatch: Watch for penalty language, safe harbors, audit relief, or certification grace periods that change contractor incentives.
records.nextAction: Monitor hearings, NDAA amendments, and acquisition-policy riders that reference CMMC, DFARS cyber clauses, or defense industrial base incidents.

records.billNumber: Naval and shipbuilding industrial base watch
records.title: Shipbuilding, submarine production, and supplier-base funding
records.plainSummary: Tracks congressional direction for Navy shipbuilding, submarine production capacity, supplier development, workforce support, and multi-year procurement authorities.
records.fundingContractSignal: Identify funds targeted to shipyards, component suppliers, workforce pipelines, and production bottlenecks across the maritime defense base.
records.regulationBonusWatch: Watch for delivery incentives, penalty clauses, domestic-content requirements, and workforce grant conditions.
records.nextAction: Track seapower markup language, appropriations tables, and committee report directions tied to production capacity or schedule slippage.

records.title: Munitions procurement, surge capacity, and replenishment authorities

sponsors.fullName: Readiness, tactical air, land forces, and appropriations members

cosponsors.fullName: Members focused on defense industrial capacity

records.plainSummary: Tracks legislation and report language that expands production lines, replenishes inventories, or creates flexible contracting tools for missiles, artillery, and other munitions.
records.fundingContractSignal: Watch for advance procurement, multi-year buys, Defense Production Act usage, facility modernization grants, and supplier diversification.
records.regulationBonusWatch: Monitor cost-sharing, milestone incentives, reporting requirements, and restrictions on sole-source production expansions.
records.nextAction: Compare authorization and appropriations language for production-rate assumptions, funding gaps, and contractor deliverables.

records.billNumber: Contractor compensation and bonus guardrails watch
records.title: Defense contractor bonus, award-fee, and executive-compensation restrictions

sponsors.fullName: Oversight, Armed Services, and appropriations members

committeeReferral: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
records.plainSummary: Focuses on proposals that would limit reimbursement, award fees, bonuses, or executive compensation for defense contractors tied to poor performance, overruns, or compliance failures.
records.fundingContractSignal: Flag provisions that make compensation unallowable, claw back fees, or condition future awards on delivery and compliance metrics.
records.regulationBonusWatch: Primary watch item: congressional efforts to reshape contractor bonuses, award fees, and executive-pay reimbursement rules.
records.nextAction: Monitor watchdog reports, hearing transcripts, and amendments responding to cost overruns or contract-performance failures.
